title: performance(canary): adaptive auto-detection for latency/throughput regressions + rollout guards
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds an adaptive performance canary detector and stronger rollout guards to reduce false positives during noisy windows and automatically halt/rollback canary traffic on confirmed latency or throughput regressions. This change introduces a two-stage detection pipeline: (1) short-window statistical detector for rapid signals, (2) confirmation stage with hysteresis and model-specific baseline adjustment. It also adds configurable hysteresis parameters, KV-cache-aware thresholds, traffic-shift annealing, and integrations with the Console dashboards for real-time visualization. Motivation: recent incidents where transient GPU scheduling spikes triggered canary rollbacks caused user-visible flaps. We need a detection pipeline that distinguishes short-lived noise from sustained regressions and provides safe automatic rollback while allowing automated canary promotion when stable. The description below is a continuous string with checklists and links: Checklist: - [x] Add adaptive detector algorithm and unit tests - [x] Add e2e perf canary integration tests using perf-canary harness - [x] Add rollout guard config and defaults - [x] Add Console dashboard link + alerting - [x] Update docs and release notes Related: ENG-1427 (perf stability), ENG-2159 (canary rollouts), SUP-88 (customer escalations); Design doc: internal/design/perf-canary-autodetect.md. Key behaviors: - Detect regressions on p50/p95 latency and RPS throughput using rolling windows (30s short, 10m confirm) and a delta-based threshold with adaptive baseline that discounts warmup and quantization changes. - Hysteresis: rollback only after confirm window observes >threshold for two consecutive confirm windows, or if short-window amplitude exceeds Xx baseline and correlates with KV cache miss spikes. - Traffic shifting: implement exponential annealing (10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%) with abort conditions after each step. - Backoff & cooldown: after abort, canary disabled for configurable cooldown (default 30m). - Console: new per-canary panel shows p50/p95, RPS, cache-miss rate, and detector state. Compatibility: defaults preserve existing behavior; ops can opt-in to stricter mode via rollout policy.

review_conversation: Marco: Can we avoid hardcoding hysteresis windows? Suggest adding operator-configurable defaults and a cluster-level override.
Author (Aisha): Agree - added RolloutPolicy config with hysteresis_window, confirm_windows_required, and cooldown_minutes. Kept safe defaults to match current behavior.
Evan: Detector looks good; please ensure KV-cache miss rate is available in the metrics pipeline at 10s granularity before enabling by default.
Author (Aisha): Added a fallback that disables KV-aware thresholding if cache-miss metric isn't present and logs a warning. Also added a quickcheck in the e2e harness to simulate cache misses.
Priya: Need a runbook update: what to do if detector repeatedly aborts canaries due to noisy infra?

Author (Aisha): Added runbook section in docs and Console alert link that suggests steps (increase confirm_window, disable KV-aware mode, or pin model version) and created a Linear follow-up ENG-2310 to improve infra noise detection.
merge_outcome: Merged by Marco Ruiz (squash) on 2026-02-20; merge_commit: m9n8k7l - release-note: minor
release_notes: Add adaptive perf canary detector with short and confirm windows to reduce false-positive rollbacks.
Introduce rollout guard defaults: hysteresis, traffic annealing, cooldown after abort.
Console dashboard for per-canary metrics (latency p50/p95, RPS, cache-miss rate) and detector state.
Backward compatible defaults; operators can tune via RolloutPolicy.
notes_on_testing: Added unit tests for detector edge cases, integration tests using perf-canary harness (simulated latency spikes, KV-cache miss correlations), and e2e tests for traffic annealing/abort flow. Local perf-smoke validated with stable baseline on G4 and A100 pools.
